scope: Finite proof packets, not a formal metatheorem

cases.name: R0_nonzero_seed
cases.meaning: R0 yields the successor of a nonzero seed.

cases.name: RS_used_state
cases.meaning: RS substitutes a genuinely used scalar state.

cases.name: RS_constant_body
cases.meaning: A constant body still requires the predecessor iterator to be valid.

cases.name: RS_compound_previous_counter
cases.meaning: The checker constructs a successor around an arbitrary prior-counter term.

cases.name: reflexivity_zero
cases.meaning: Reflexivity is derived from constant RS.

cases.name: reflexivity_two
cases.meaning: Reflexivity at a nonzero term.

cases.name: equation_progress
cases.meaning: An equation induction uses the induction hypothesis and RS.

cases.name: compound_target_QE
cases.meaning: Q specialization at a compound numerical target.

cases.name: nested_closure
cases.meaning: Compound case introduction retains a passive parameter through inner induction.

cases.name: nonvacuous_DE
cases.meaning: A nonvacuous existential witness is opened, used, and discharged.

cases.name: contextual_induction
cases.meaning: An essential retained equality supplies a base for equation induction.

cases.name: transport_under_Q
cases.meaning: Transport through a compound formula.

cases.name: neutral_endpoints
cases.meaning: A harmless endpoint mismatch is followed by a real proof.

cases.name: neutral_target
cases.meaning: Matching endpoints with a mismatched target leave the target unchanged.

cases.name: compound_progress_forbidden
cases.meaning: A forged compound induction uses B(z); the kernel supplies B(0).

cases.name: false_zero_one
cases.meaning: Computations cannot prove 0=1.

cases.name: old_zero_seed_equation
cases.meaning: The old I0 equation is false for the new successor-seeded R.

cases.name: free_label
cases.meaning: Unallocated labels reject.

cases.name: bad_major
cases.meaning: A false major cannot fall through into a successful continuation.

cases.name: false_after_neutral
cases.meaning: Neutral requests do not prove false targets.

cases.name: false_annotated_counter_equation
cases.meaning: Constructing the successor prevents the false equation R(0,0;0)=0.

cases.name: base_ignores_counter_field
cases.meaning: A base packet constructs counter zero; its unused prior-counter field is inert.

cases.name: invalid_seed
cases.meaning: A used recursive image validates its entire seed and update.

cases.name: invalid_update
cases.meaning: Mappings are not update syntax.

cases.name: exposed_update_alias
cases.meaning: An exposed update coordinate forces validation of the old recursor.

cases.name: four_field_goal
cases.meaning: Constructor arity checking remains charged.

cases.name: forged_parameter_reflexivity
cases.meaning: A theorem-shaped packet still cannot name an unallocated global parameter.

cases.name: future_DI_witness
cases.meaning: Mutation of a substantive accepted derivation.

cases.name: progress_replaced_by_base
cases.meaning: Mutation of a substantive accepted derivation.

cases.name: future_QE_target
cases.meaning: Mutation of a substantive accepted derivation.

cases.name: fresh_witness_computation_alias
cases.meaning: A safe generated equation has a known zero instance; later reflexivity closes.
